title: The Best Matter Presence Sensors
subtitle: Presence sensors that work with every major smart home platform.
intro: Matter presence sensors are new, so this list is short. We scored the ones on Amazon on rating, review volume, and features.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.a: A motion sensor (PIR) sees movement, so lights turn off if you sit still. An mmWave presence sensor detects breathing-level motion, so it knows you're still in the room while you read or work.
Most mmWave sensors need USB or wall power because the radar runs constantly. A few newer battery models combine PIR and mmWave to save power.

buyers_guide.q: Can it tell where I am in the room?
buyers_guide.a: Some models, like the Aqara FP2, support zones, so a desk, couch, and bed can trigger different automations.
